[spoiler=THE ARELIAN 4TH FLEET DEPARTS FROM PORT]
[i]The Hyacinth Post - Der Hyacinth Post Printes. Monday, March 19th 2028 [/i]

This evening, The Arelian 4th Fleet departed, charting a course for the Ernhardt Special Economic Zone. 
Led by Vice Admiral Prior Graves, this force comprises 15 Frigates,  9 Destroyers, 7 Crusiers, 1 Carrier, 5 signature Battleships, and 11 Corvettes  of which, 2 Frigates and all Corvettes are to lead Zone Security. 

It is a significant departure from Navy Doctrine, which has always prioritised protecting our home and supporting the Army through naval bombardments. It carries the potential of compromising our diplomatic position for power projection, burdening our Armed Forces with extension.

Chief of Naval Staff, Admiral Andreissen, has delivered a statement to the press, expressing that this decision was to support zone security, stating that It is decided.

This follows the signing of [url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2756252]the Ernhardt Charter[/url], which created the Special Zone with Valonia. 
Valonia is expected to receive them Saturday morning.

[/spoiler]
